_comment: OPUS-301 single machine-readable source-of-truth for provider model defaults. Consumed by Python (kernel/model_registry.py), Rust (src-tauri/src/backend/model_registry.rs, include_str!), TS (ui/src/lib/modelRegistry.ts), Dart (mobile/lib/standalone/llm_client.dart) and the coding agents / agent_generator. Enforced cross-language for anthropic this batch; other providers are managed at their own call sites and are NOT in this SoT yet (OPUS-301b). Cross-language sync + retired-id scan: scripts/check_model_registry.py. 'retired' = official retired snapshots; 'legacy_aliases' = ids a previous KALI UI may have stored (incl. typos) — both migrate to 'default' and must never appear as an active default/option.
